[image: Ballots go in the mail by October 16, and Spokane County's may arrive early. Watch your mailbox! Here's how to help: 1. Fill it out top to bottom and return it early. 2. Post a photo of your sealed envelope (never your marked ballot) with #FlipWA05. 3. Tag three friends and ask if theirs has arrived. Dem clubs and Indivisible groups: please share this with your members. Every early ballot frees up volunteers to reach the voters who haven't heard from us yet.]

[image: Northwest Public Broadcasting wrote up our Walla Walla forum, and the contrast is right there in the record. On trade: tariffs are a tax, and Walla Walla's wine industry is getting hit hard. In February, Michael Baumgartner voted against normalizing trade with Canada, our second-largest trading partner. On health care: the bill he voted for cuts more than $900 billion from Medicaid over the next decade, and rural hospitals across this district depend on it. Read the full story: https://www.nwpb.org/local/2026-10-05/baumgartner-vs-conroy-washington-states-5th-congressional-district-candidates-talk-trade-medicaid-affordability-data-centers]

[image: The Visibility Brigade took over the Regal Street bridge, and homemade signs stole the show. "Gaslighting won't fill your tank." "Vote early – less worry." Thanks to Kari Walters, Pat Bates, and everyone involved.]

[image: Three weeks to go — and this campaign is moving! This week’s Conroy Connection is a look at what’s happening on the ground as we head into the final stretch: volunteers stepping up in new ways, neighbors organizing, recent press coverage, new endorsements, upcoming events, and plenty of opportunities to get involved. The big moments matter, but so do the little ones — the phone calls, the doors knocked, the signs waved, the late-night emails, and all the work people do when nobody is watching. Take a look at what the campaign has been up to and what’s ahead as we move toward Election Day!]
